title: Scaling and Renormalization in Neural Networks: An Effective Renormalization-Group Description of Grokking
abstract: arXiv:2610.36113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorization to generalization in deep neural networks (NNs). We examine whether scaling and renormalization group (RG) theories can describe this dynamics, establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions. For modular addition on a two-layer NN, an ensemble of trained models defines an order parameter (the squared weight norm) and fluctuation proxies for the heat capacity and the susceptibility, with training epoch and weight decay serving as thermal and field control coordinates. To bridge neural architectures to real-space RG, we construct an exact coupling matrix via a second-order expansion of the loss with respect to per-neuron norms and use its Fiedler vector to define an effective geometry. This spectral ordering yields a monotonic spatial decay of coupling strength that is absent under random permutations. We then execute real-space RG by block-spin aggr

translated_title: 神经网络中的标度与重整化：Grokking现象的有效重整化群描述
translated_abstract: Grokking是深度神经网络中从记忆到泛化的延迟转变。我们研究了标度理论和重整化群（RG）理论能否描述这一动力学过程，从而为神经泛化转变建立一个定量的物理框架。针对二层神经网络上的模加法任务，一组训练好的模型集合定义了序参量（权重范数的平方）以及热容和磁化率的涨落代理量，其中训练轮次和权重衰减分别充当热学控制坐标和场控制坐标。为了将神经架构与实空间重整化群联系起来，我们通过对损失函数关于各神经元范数进行二阶展开，构建了一个精确的耦合矩阵，并利用其Fiedler向量来定义有效几何结构。这种谱排序产生了耦合强度的单调空间衰减，而这一特性在随机置换下并不存在。随后，我们通过块自旋聚合执行实空间重整化群变换……
tldr: 该论文将重整化群物理理论引入神经网络Grokking现象研究，通过基于神经元耦合矩阵谱排序的实空间重整化方法，为神经网络的记忆到泛化转变建立了定量的物理描述框架。
en_tdlr: This paper applies renormalization-group theory to the grokking phenomenon in neural networks, constructing an exact coupling matrix with spectral ordering to define an effective geometry, thereby establishing a quantitative physical framework for neural generalization transitions.
